reviews.x: I didn’t know what to expect considering there are no reviews but I love them.

Gorgeous lashes and they were very soft! I had to cut them to fit my eyes but I have to do that with almost all of my lashes. I didn’t use the lash tweezers that came with them because I just use regular tweezers but it was very convenient that they came with them. I thought the lash glue was going to be black but it was actually clear and I was very happy about that because I usually use the clear duo lash glue. Very tacky once dry and held the lashes on all night.

reviews.t: No point of  buying $$$ lashes, when these are just as good, period !
reviews.x: These lashes are great for the price! I do wish the glue would hold a little better, which you can add more.  But the bottle seems to not have much glue in it. But for the price, it's worth it. (Your getting g three pairs, an applicator and glue for 9 bucks , come on now ! Lol) Now I do wish I would've ordered a smaller size.  That was my own fault. They were very dramatic for my taste. But the quality is great for the price. I dont see why spend so much for the same thing??  Definitely am going

these lashes are absolutely perfect for everyday use. not too dramatic, but just enough to enhance your natural beauty. they were the perfect size for my eye shape so i did not have to cut these. they also come with glue & a tool that helps you get the lash all the way down to the lash line if you have trouble doing it with your fingers. i feel that i could dress these up or down. i definitely recommend.

This was my first time buying lashes and I’m so glad I did! These babies held up so well through the night. Even after running and screaming my way through 2-3 haunted houses these were stuck like a champ. They compliment my eyes so well and were a really good length

reviews.t: As far from "natural" as it gets.
reviews.x: These lashes were not even close to natural. The first time I wore them was to a showing of Rocky Horror. The lashes were so long they were brushing my eyebrows and my friends were joking that if I blinked a little faster I'd take flight. They were super heavy and irritating. The glue did hold well though and the applicator is nice quality. I had to trim the lashes down significantly for a look I could actually wear out and about, though. And I do not have small eyes. These lashes are fine quali
Me encantaron!!! Siempre e batallado mucho para sabérmelas poner, estas son fáciles de poner, súper cómodas, y el tamaño perfecto. Las volvería a comprar sin duda!!!

Okay, I ordered the 710 lashes (the thinner of the two) and at first glance I was a little nervous when they arrived that they were going to be huge and look ridiculous. These lashes are honestly amazing for the price. I have been wearing lashes for awhile now and I always have trouble with thicker bands, these are not thick strip bands like most full lashes have. They bend and are flexible to help shape to your eye and they do give some drama but nothing too crazy. Would definitely recommend, w

I don’t usually write reviews but these eyelashes were perfect.  I am quite inexperienced when it comes to false eyelashes and I was just buying them for Halloween so I figured I would get the whole kit all together and the price for these was right.  I was so impressed, they were easy to apply, the glue held all day and they looked incredible, I got soooooo many compliments!  I would definitely recommend these for anyone looking to get a nice dramatic doll like effect.

reviews.t: Not the best but not bad
reviews.x: The lashes are very pretty but dramatic. They are fairly easy to apply. That being said glue drys out fast and they arent the cutest style and a bit pokey on the eye. They are not very light weight they kind drup in your eye, i definitely have lashes that are better. The applicator is very nice  and for the price it isnt bad. Probably wont repurchase, but hey it isnt that bad and lashes last pretty long and i still wear them
I wore these for Halloween...only the second time wearing them in my whole life. They were easy to apply. Not the least bit realistic looking in my opinion but definitely worked for me for Halloween.
These lashes are so beautiful. They make my eyes pop and so sexy looking. I highly recommend these lashes, I will be buying more for sure.
The lashes are very big. The glue was completely dried out and I had to buy a new one separately. dont recommend.
Eyelash Arrived broken and dried out. Not useable or salvageable. Beautiful lashes but without the glue no use.
The lashes are amazing, the glue was dried out.
Glue arrived COMPLETELY dried out. Returned.

Great staring kit with the eyelash glue, tweezers, and falsies! This was my first set of falsies and the inclusion of the tweezers made it super easy to apply the lashes! The adhesive on the falsies were a little difficult to remove but doesn't affect how it applies to your eyes.  I have mono-lid eyes and wearing the falsies do cause my eyes to crease into a double-lid. It's a very dramatic look and really makes my eyes look bigger. Overall, it's a great kit to start with!

I'm a beginner for wearing lashes so I was sort of nervous about getting these thinking they would be super hard. It does in fact come with the applicator and its own glue, which can I just say is amazing, still holding up and the glue ran out but it was good while it lasted (also the glue is a brush tip application so that definitely helps). Definitely would recommend for beginner lash wearers it gave me a great experience.

The package was not sealed. The applicator is scratched and rusted. The glue seems used, the bottle was dirty on the outside and the glue inside seems to be drying up. The little tray that holds the lashes was also dirty. Was it used? I will most definitively NOT be putting these anywhere near my eyes. It is a shame because the lashes seem long and fabulous, I was very much looking forward to learn how to use them. =(

Soo I’m gonna start off by saying these are the first lashes I’ve ever bought or wore.. I’m not an expert my any means. That being said, I LOVE these lashes, they’re natural looking, easy to apply, and very realistic looking!  I did have to cut them down a little bit so they weren’t so long. I’m not exactly sure if that’s what you are supposed to do or not. 🤷🏻‍♀️  I would highly recommend these lashes!

reviews.t: Nada en estos momentos estoy molesta 😡
reviews.x: Me molesta que no se fijen las direcciones y dejen los pedidos en otra casa que  porfavor fijense bien donde dejan cada pedido ya van varios pedido que me los dejan en otro casa q no es la mía acaso no pueden ver el numero de casa 😡 me molesta xq loque avia pedido las personas ya hasta lo avian abierto y así abierto y con todo de fuera me lo dejaron en el buzón que falta de profesionalismo es ese 😡😡

I wanted to like these lashes but I wish I would have purchased my normal ones from the store. I will say the quality of the actual lashes looked and felt great. But the inner eye part of the strip felt scratchy and uncomfortable. The glue was my least favorite part. Took forever to finally stick and then would NOT come out of my real lashes when I removed the lashes.

reviews.t: Great, but glue was dried in the bottle
reviews.x: I really like these lashes! They're very long and dramatic and super easy to apply because of the tweezers! There's only one downside. The glue that came with mine was VERY VERY dry. The glue is very chunky and thick. It dried up within about a week or two from using it. I eventually had to use my own glue, but thats not TOO big of a problem.

These lashes are AMAZING!!! Highly recommend these beautiful lashes! They are as described in the picture and description. I have gotten so many compliments since wearing them! They are so soft and look so real! They also came in beautiful packaging. They are so long they touch my brows. The glue is great and easy to apply! MUST BUY!

Package comes with 3 pairs of lashes, glue and an applicator. Presentation is great and the lashes themselves are beautiful! I will definitely continue getting my lashes here as opposed to buying a single pair for twice the amount of money at other places. If you’re doubting getting them, I advise you go for it!! Worth every penny!!

claims.text: Most reviewers love the lashes, praising their appearance and value for the price.
Several reviewers report the included glue was dried out or unusable.
Many reviewers find the lashes easy to apply, especially helpful for beginners.
Some reviewers say the lashes are too dramatic, long, or heavy rather than natural.
Reviewers appreciate that the kit includes an applicator tool and glue.
